data.name: Bijoy
data.gender_notes: Bijoy is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bijoy is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhī' which means 'to be'. The prefix 'Joy' signifies happiness and joy. This name is given to a child to bring joy and happiness in their lives. The name Bijoy carries the meaning “Joy, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bijoy usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May the name Bijoy bring you constant joy and happiness in all walks of life.
data.etymology: Bijoy belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, Happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bijoy total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Bijoy is a popular male name in the Hindu community, especially in Bengali culture. It is believed that this name not only brings happiness and joy but also ensures the prosperity and success of the individual. Bijoy is also considered a lucky name and is often given to a child when the stars are aligned in the astrological sense.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Bijoy holds deep spiritual significance as it signifies the joy and happiness that comes from within. It is believed that the name Bijoy helps the bearer to remain joyful and content despite the ups and downs of life. Additionally, the name is associated with Lord Ganesha, the creator of wisdom and the remover of obstacles. Wishing someone the name Bijoy is a way to bless them with happiness, prosperity, and wisdom.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bijoy: Bringer of Joy or Victory in spiritual battles. It symbolizes the triumph of good over evil, and the joy and happiness that comes with inner peace and self-realization.
